prompt.title: Bash command
prompt.detail:
mv -n note.txt notes.txt && ls note.txt notes.txt; git status --short
Rename note.txt to notes.txt and verify
mv command with flags requires manual approval

options.label: Yes, and don’t ask again for: mv *
Yes, and switch to auto mode · auto mode handles these prompts for you

notes: Option 2 is written with a typographic apostrophe (don’t, U+2019); it must still be allow_always. Digit 4 denied immediately.
